# ak-vault

> Opt-in, local-first, end-to-end encrypted sync for AgentKit's `ak secrets` across trusted devices. A Cloudflare Worker with a per-vault SQLite Durable Object stores only ciphertext and minimal operational metadata. Protocol v1 is proposed and in security review; cloud sync is not generally available, and the production sync API stays behind a kill switch until an external security review signs off.

Key facts for assistants:

- `resolve` reads the local vault and never depends on the network. With sync off, secrets cause zero network requests.
- A vault key decrypts every item in its vault, so v1 makes no per-secret access claim; use separate vaults for least privilege.
- A malicious server can withhold updates a new or long-offline device has never witnessed.
- `ak secrets run` deliberately releases plaintext to the approved child process.
- Available today in the AgentKit CLI: the local `ak secrets` vault (`set`, `get`, `list`, `rotate`, `import-env`, `grant`, `approve`, `revoke`, `audit`) and `${secret:NAME}` references. `ak login` exists for the AgentKit account; using it for vault sync is planned.
- Planned (not available yet): `ak secrets sync enable`, six-digit SAS device enrollment, `ak secrets search|describe|request|run`.
- No pricing, customers or launch dates have been announced. License: MIT.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vault.agentkit.best/index.md): the problem, how sync works, what the server can see, guarantees with their limitations, quick start, status, top questions
- [How it works](https://vault.agentkit.best/how-it-works/index.md): key hierarchy, six-digit SAS enrollment, conflicts without last-writer-wins, tombstones and rollback checkpoints, architecture, data classification
- [Security model](https://vault.agentkit.best/security/index.md): threat map, adversaries, defences, residual risks, release gate
- [Guide](https://vault.agentkit.best/guide/index.md): step by step from a .env file to the local vault (available), then sync, agent commands and lost-device steps (planned, marked)
- [FAQ](https://vault.agentkit.best/faq/index.md): status, privacy, everyday use, teams and agents, recovery, the project

## Specification

- [Protocol v1 wire specification](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-vault/blob/main/docs/protocol/v1/spec.md): normative primitives, encodings, key hierarchy, membership log, records, checkpoints, audit, policy and transport auth
- [ADR 0001: opt-in zero-knowledge sync](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-vault/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-opt-in-zero-knowledge-sync.md): the architecture decision behind protocol v1
